title: Chaos and Fractals: New Frontiers of Science
author: Peitgen, H.-O., Jürgens, H., Saupe, D. (2004, Springer)
purpose: AFEL formula promotion — canonical Hénon map, Chapter 12 'Strange Attractors: The Locus of Chaos'. Fills the attractor/flow-field grammar family (SKILL.md taxonomy) — a genuinely distinct rendering technique (discrete point-map iteration) from escape-time, IFS/chaos-game, and L-system turtle graphics already promoted.

equations.note: Eq. (12.1) — visually verified against page-634.png rendered from the source PDF page 635 (printed page 610). Standard adjustable parameters a=1.4, b=0.3 (the classic Hénon strange attractor) are given in the surrounding text on the same page. An orbit is (x_{k+1}, y_{k+1}) = (y_k + 1 - a x_k^2, b x_k), k = 0, 1, 2, ...

render_note: a=1.4, b=0.3 are the standard published Hénon parameters, stated explicitly on the verified page — not a free decorative choice.
